MILES EXECUTIVE DIRECTIVE

BUILD 043

Engineering Writer Mode

Current behavior:

EngineeringImprovementService analyzes the system and generates proposals.

New capability:

EngineeringImprovementService shall become capable of generating production-ready replacement scripts.

When an approved engineering proposal exists:

1. Generate the complete replacement file.
2. Preserve all existing functionality.
3. Apply only the approved engineering changes.
4. Validate syntax.
5. Produce rollback instructions.
6. Do NOT write directly into production.
7. Save the replacement script into:

DATA/engineering_replacements/

Each replacement shall include:

- target file
- complete replacement source
- validation commands
- rollback instructions
- summary of changes

EngineeringImprovementService shall never return only a proposal when "Generate Replacement Script" is requested.

Instead, it shall generate the complete production-ready replacement.

Do not modify production automatically.

Only generate the replacement package.
